import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import HashingVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Configuration
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/en_train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/en_test_2.csv"
SUB_DIR = "./submission"


def main():
    print("Loading data...")
    # Load necessary columns to minimize memory usage
    train = pd.read_csv(
        TRAIN_PATH, usecols=["before", "after", "sentence_id", "token_id"]
    )
    test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH, usecols=["sentence_id", "token_id", "before"])

    # Construct submission IDs
    train["id"] = train["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + train["token_id"].astype(str)
    test["id"] = test["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test["token_id"].astype(str)

    # Hold-out validation split (no stratification due to highly imbalanced multi-class distribution)
    train_sub, val_sub = train_test_split(train, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)
    print(f"Hold-out split: Train={len(train_sub)}, Val={len(val_sub)}")

    # Vectorize using character n-grams hashing for speed and memory efficiency
    print("Vectorizing text data...")
    vec = HashingVectorizer(
        n_features=2**17,
        alternate_sign=False,
        norm=None,
        analyzer="char",
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        dtype=np.float32,
        salt=42,
    )

    # Convert to lists for slightly faster processing
    X_train = vec.transform(train_sub["before"].tolist())
    y_train = train_sub["after"].values
    X_val = vec.transform(val_sub["before"].tolist())
    y_val = val_sub["after"].values

    # Convert to CSR for optimal LightGBM sparse matrix handling
    X_train = X_train.tocsr()
    X_val = X_val.tocsr()

    # Initialize and train LightGBM classifier
    print("Training model...")
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=300,
        max_depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        num_leaves=31,
        min_child_samples=25,
        subsample=0.85,
        colsample_bytree=0.85,
        n_jobs=-1,
        verbosity=-1,
        random_state=42,
    )
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)

    # Evaluate on genuine hold-out validation set
    print("Evaluating on validation set...")
    val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
    val_acc = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred)
    print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_acc:.4f}")

    # Generate predictions on the test set
    print("Generating test predictions...")
    X_test = vec.transform(test["before"].tolist()).tocsr()
    test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

    # Save submission file
    os.makedirs(SUB_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"], "after": test_pred})
    submission_path = os.path.join(SUB_DIR, "submission.csv")
    submission.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
    print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
